pages.text: Each phase a boss uses stronger powers; the strikes that hurt most show first — a line or a ring of motes: step out of it. $(l)Kerrigan$(): pools of $(l)liquid creep$() lie on her arena, she heals standing in them and goes to them when hurt — break them (one blow each); new pools grow at each phase. Third phase: the $(l)blade storm$(), a star of dashes round you.

$(l)Raynor$(): his energy fills; full, he aims for two seconds — a red line shows the shot, fixed for its last half second — and fires a round that pierces everything for 30 blocks: step off the line. Second phase: the $(l)Hyperion's laser$() burns a line across the deck after its warning. Third: needle rounds in a fan, and his energy fills faster.

$(l)Artanis$(): second phase, walls of psionic force cut the arena for eight seconds; third, the $(l)Spear of Adun$() burns three lines across it from orbit. $(l)The other worlds' heroes$(): Tosh a lockdown, then a nuke; Zeratul a void prison, then a storm of blinks; Zagara more banelings and hydralisks each phase; Horner a missile barrage; Stukov infested terrans; Selendis purifier lines.
